# 10x Velocity — https://10xvelocity.ai
# AI & Automation Consulting | Louisville, Kentucky | Serving clients nationally
# Last updated: 2026-06-10

## Who we are

10x Velocity is a veteran-owned (VOSB Verified) AI & automation consulting firm
based in Louisville, Kentucky, serving mid-market companies (50-500 employees)
and nonprofits nationally. We map business processes, build targeted AI and
automation solutions, and train teams to run them independently. Implementations
are typically live within 4-8 weeks.

Contact: info@10xvelocity.ai | +1 (502) 804-2559
Address: 10440 Bluegrass Pkwy, Louisville, KY 40299
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/10x-velocity

## Pricing (published)

Amplify Meetings pair each client with a dedicated AI Strategist and a
dedicated Automation Architect. 4-week billing, no long-term contract, no
onboarding fees, scale up or down at any time.

- 10xV Core — $2,500 per 4 weeks. Biweekly 90-minute Amplify Meeting on a
  standing cadence; 5 hours of build time between each session (10 hours per
  cycle); documentation and handoff; client portal and async support.
- 10xV Growth — $5,000 per 4 weeks. Weekly 90-minute Amplify Meeting; 5 hours
  of build time between each session (20 hours per cycle); same inclusions as
  Core.
- 10xV Pro — $10,000 per 4 weeks. Twice-weekly 90-minute Amplify Meetings;
  5 hours of build time between each session (40 hours per cycle); for teams
  moving across multiple departments.
- Single Session — $999. One 2-hour working session, no ongoing commitment.
  Opportunity mapping, team training, or a technical deep dive.
- Build Accelerator add-on doubles build time between sessions: +$1,300 on
  Core, +$2,600 on Growth, +$5,200 on Pro. Meeting cadence is unchanged.
- Larger custom automation projects (multi-system workflows, voice agents,
  document processing pipelines) are scoped inside the engagement.
Details: https://10xvelocity.ai/packages
